description: Tool to retrieve line items for a Checkout Session. Use when you need to view the items, pricing, quantities, and totals for a specific checkout session.

ending_before.description: A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.
limit.title: Limit

session.description: The ID of the Checkout Session.
session.title: Session

starting_after.description: A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.
starting_after.title: Starting After

name: get_checkout_sessions_session_line_items

enabled.description: Whether the quantity can be adjusted by the customer.
enabled.title: Enabled

maximum.description: The maximum quantity the customer can select.
maximum.title: Maximum

minimum.description: The minimum quantity the customer can select.
minimum.title: Minimum

has_more.description: Whether more items exist for pagination.
has_more.title: Has More

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'list'.
object.title: Object

url.description: The URL for accessing this list.
url.title: Url

adjustable_quantity.description: Configuration for allowing customers to adjust the quantity during checkout.
adjustable_quantity.title: Adjustable Quantity

amount_discount.description: Total discount amount applied in cents.
amount_discount.title: Amount Discount

amount_subtotal.description: Subtotal amount before tax in cents.
amount_subtotal.title: Amount Subtotal

amount_total.description: Total amount including tax and discounts in cents.
amount_total.title: Amount Total

id.description: Unique identifier for the line item.
id.title: Id

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs attached to the line item.
metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'item'.
object.title: Object

price.description: The Price object associated with this line item.
price.title: Price

active.description: Whether the price can be used for new purchases.
active.title: Active

billing_scheme.description: Describes how to compute the price per period. Either 'per_unit' or 'tiered'.
billing_scheme.title: Billing Scheme

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

custom_unit_amount.description: When set, provides configuration for the amount to be adjusted by the customer during Checkout Sessions and Payment Links.
custom_unit_amount.title: Custom Unit Amount

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

lookup_key.description: A lookup key used to retrieve prices dynamically from a static string.
lookup_key.title: Lookup Key

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

nickname.description: A brief description of the price, hidden from customers.
nickname.title: Nickname

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'price'.
object.title: Object

product.description: The ID of the product this price is associated with.
product.title: Product

recurring.description: The recurring components of a price such as interval and usage_type.
recurring.title: Recurring

tax_behavior.description: Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes.
tax_behavior.title: Tax Behavior

tiers_mode.description: Defines if the tiering price should be graduated or volume based.
tiers_mode.title: Tiers Mode

transform_quantity.description: Apply a transformation to the reported usage or set quantity before computing the amount billed.
transform_quantity.title: Transform Quantity

type.description: One of 'one_time' or 'recurring' depending on whether the price is for a one-time purchase or a recurring (subscription) purchase.
type.title: Type

unit_amount.description: The unit amount in cents to be charged, represented as a whole integer if possible.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: The unit amount in cents to be charged, represented as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

maximum.description: The maximum unit amount the customer can specify for this item.
maximum.title: Maximum

minimum.description: The minimum unit amount the customer can specify for this item.
minimum.title: Minimum

preset.description: The starting unit amount which can be updated by the customer.
preset.title: Preset

interval.description: The frequency at which a subscription is billed. One of 'day', 'week', 'month', or 'year'.
interval.title: Interval

interval_count.description: The number of intervals between subscription billings.
interval_count.title: Interval Count

round.description: After division, either round the result up or down.
round.title: Round
